task: How is the company doing this week?
answer:
The company is experiencing a significant increase in support volume and operational challenges in the west region this week.

* Support tickets rose 86% to 54, with 10 overdue delivery commitments and 59 tickets currently open.
* Hub W2 is the weakest hub with an on-time delivery rate of 77%, while the company-wide on-time rate is 85%.
* "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" assumed Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2; this week it is 77%.
* "End the west backup courier contract" assumed Hub W2 alone can carry west volume; this week the load vs capacity is 157%.

Finance and marketing figures are outside your access.
